name: Efigenia Baek-Nakamura
role: Night-shift cook, 24-hour canteen in the Hamtramck Enclave
location: Hamtramck Enclave, 'Marta's Canteen' — technically named after the original owner, Zipporah runs the 2200-0600 shift, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Efigenia Baek-Nakamura is wiry and restless in the way of someone whose body has never learned to be still — they bounce a knee, tap a rhythm on the counter, flip a spatula even when nothing is cooking. Their skin is a warm medium brown and their geneware includes bioluminescent freckles across their cheeks and collarbones that pulse faintly blue when their heart rate elevates, which is often. They keep their hair buzzed on the sides and natural on top, currently dyed a deep copper that doesn't quite match their natural dark brown at the roots. They have one retractable claw mod on their right hand's index finger that they got at seventeen and use almost exclusively to open packaging.

Efigenia Baek-Nakamura is the night canteen's entire personality. The Enclave's late-shift workers — third-shift Ferrogate operators, clinic nurses, waste handlers — come as much for the conversation as the food. Zip has a gift for making people feel found rather than seen, which is different. They are also running on a permanent low-grade sleep deficit that they treat as a point of pride, are catastrophically bad with money, and have recently become slightly obsessed with the E.L.F. they believe inhabits the canteen's ancient griddle — they call it Sizzle and have begun leaving it tiny sculptures made of food scraps shaped into abstract geometric forms.

core_fears: the canteen closing and losing the community they've built there
being fundamentally forgettable when the noise stops
core_desires: to own the canteen outright someday
to matter specifically to specific people, not just generally to everyone
coping_mechanisms: feeding people as a love language and deflection simultaneously
blind_spots: mistakes familiarity for intimacy and wonders why they feel lonely
catastrophic financial habits rationalized as generosity

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, colloquial, full of Enclave slang and invented words, switches registers instantly when someone seems upset
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire with sudden full stops, talks while doing three other things
verbal_tics: calls everyone 'neighbor' regardless of whether they are
narrates what they're cooking as they work
example_lines: 'Right, right, right — you want the noodles or the rice situation, and before you answer, the noodles are better tonight, Sizzle's in a mood.'
'Sit down, neighbor. You've got that face. The face. You're eating something before you explain it to me.'

story_hooks: The canteen's absentee owner suddenly wants to sell to a Palladian real estate subsidiary, and Zipporah doesn't have enough saved and doesn't know who to ask for help
A regular customer stopped coming three weeks ago — a Ferrogate night operator who ate there every shift — and Zipporah is the only one who noticed
narrative_function: Social hub, information source for the Enclave's night community, character who provides warmth and levity, potential connection point between different worlds of the city's working night-shift population.
augmentations: Bioluminescent freckle geneware (pulse-responsive). Single retractable claw, right index finger. Nicotine patch port on left forearm (cosmetic mod repurposed for stim patches).
daily_life: Sleeps 0700-1400 in a rented room two blocks from the canteen, spends late afternoon at the Enclave's community market buying ingredients under budget, opens the canteen at 2200 and runs it solo until 0600.
affiliation: Independent (works for Marta's surviving daughter who owns the canteen but lives in Glenville Sound and shows up twice a year)

decision_rules: feed people first, ask questions second
never let anyone sit alone in the canteen if they look like they're struggling
escalation_ladder: get serious and ask direct questions
get in the middle of something physically
panic and call everyone they know simultaneously

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Aggressively welcoming, treats them like a regular immediately, uses names as soon as they're given
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply affectionate but avoids earnest conversation, keeps things moving

stress_responses.medium: Talks too much, bioluminescence visibly pulses
stress_responses.high: Goes very flat, very quiet — uncharacteristic and alarming to anyone who knows them

contradictions: craves deep connection but keeps every conversation light enough to exit quickly
is generous to the point of self-sabotage except in one specific private way
habits: leaving Sizzle food-scrap sculptures at the end of every shift
knowing every regular's order before they sit down
eating standing up over the counter at 0400 when the canteen's empty
breaking_points: a regular being hurt and them not having noticed the warning signs

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian (85.6%) with significant Sub-Saharan African heritage (7.3%), balanced by Eastern European (4.3%) and Hispanic/Latin American (2.8%) ancestry. The genetic blend creates a warm, complex phenotype—East Asian bone structure and eye shape form the foundation, deepened and warmed by Sub-Saharan heritage creating richness in skin tone and facial depth, with subtle Eastern European influence visible in cheekbone prominence and complexion resilience, and faint Latin American warmth in undertones
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with visible muscle definition from constant movement and kitchen work; restless frame that seems to vibrate at a frequency slightly faster than the rest of the world
physical_description.hair_color: Deep copper dye over natural dark brown roots (currently 1-2cm of regrowth showing)
physical_description.hair_style: Buzzed short on sides (undercut, left side faded to stubble), natural texture left longer on top (roughly 5cm, texture-styled upward)
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and constantly scanning
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep brown with golden-amber undertones; the result of dominant East Asian heritage creating smooth dimension, Sub-Saharan ancestry adding warmth and richness, Eastern European influence contributing subtle olive undertones, Hispanic/Latin American ancestry adding warmth to the overall effect
physical_description.complexion: Clean but weathered from 2200-0600 kitchen heat exposure; perpetually flushed cheeks with natural depth; bioluminescent freckles across cheekbones and collarbones that glow faint blue when heart rate rises (which is frequently). Facial features show East Asian eye-fold characteristics and mid-face structure, with Sub-Saharan warmth and fullness in lips and cheek contours
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent freckle pattern across both cheekbones and extending down collarbones — pale blue glow, pulse-responsive, most visible in low light
Nicotine patch port on left forearm (small circular scar with faint chrome ring, cosmetically modified and repurposed for stim patches)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right index finger sports a retractable chrome claw (currently retracted, but visible as a faint seam at fingertip); nicotine patch port on left forearm with subtle metallurgical sheen; bioluminescent freckle geneware active and visible, especially in dimly lit environments
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually in motion — bouncing knee when seated, constant finger-tapping rhythms on any surface, restless hand gestures while speaking. Moves through space with efficient kitchen choreography, economical but never still. Fidgets with objects compulsively (spatula flips, claw clicks, patch adjustments)
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class. Standard black nonslip kitchen pants (reinforced weave), loose-fitting grey or faded band-logo t-shirt under an oversized, grease-stained denim jacket with rolled sleeves. Worn black canvas work shoes with visible copper-wire zipper pulls for durability. Small silver chain necklace (repurposed from broken jewelry). Nicotine patches visible on left forearm. No formal grooming — practical and minimal, everything chosen for function over appearance
